blocks.x: I got that picture of the band, but without Louie, all white suits, in Chicago, for the Mayor of Bronzeville. That's the first time I ever saw a picture of you with that band, so I knew you had to be in one.
I haven't got a picture of me with Louie.
though, it's everybody else in the band, but Louie; Biggy Madison, Charlie Holmes, Greeley, Louis Bacon, Ham Davis, Paul Barbara--
You're on that; I have it. I have that; yeah. Mayor of Bronzeville it says.
